set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- API returns feasible plan, objective, backend status, and residuals.
- Floating-marginal handling and any quantization are explicit.
- Analytic, lpSolve, and POT comparisons pass.
- Infeasible/degenerate/iteration-limit states are explicit.
- C++ backend passes all hosted platforms and performance comparison.
set.title: Expose exact balanced linear transport through the C++ simplex
